name: Local dev servers
ownerWords: A 200 check is a good duty too. Hand the 200 checks of the wiki, the frontend app, Convex and the crawler API in the local environment to the ops chat. Also, on 10-09: have it your duty to have usable mac.
goal: The owner's Mac stays usable (no minute in the last 24 h that the Mac usable watch reads unusable, the same line d7 judges by) and its search app :5174, design demo :5180 and Vent :8791 answer 200, its Convex watcher has pushed the newest convex/ change or is pushing it, us-metal02's own Convex watcher has pushed the newest convex/ change or is pushing it, the wiki (the wiki url in hosts.json), the search app (localhost:5174), the api-portal app (localhost:5175), local Convex and the local crawler-v3 API each answer 200 within 5 s, the wiki's process tree stays under 4096 MB (a wiki or search restart shows in the run detail). The M2 Air store box that hosts local Convex keeps its swap at or under 6,000 MB. Tell the owner only when a server does not answer, the wiki is over its cap, a server keeps restarting, or the Mac is overloaded.

metrics.label: Minutes in the last 24 h the owner's Mac read unusable (memory pressure critical, 6,000 or more swapouts a second, or kernel_task over one core)
The owner's Mac dev servers not answering 200 within 5 s: search app :5174, design demo :5180 and Vent :8791 /healthz (an asleep Mac reads mac_unreachable instead)
Swap used on the M2 Air store box that hosts local Convex and the dev stores (local Convex schema evals start to pass their 1 s limit over 6,000 MB, measured 10-13 to 10-27)

onMiss: Read the flagged items; each service's answer is there, and by_design means the search app uses a remote one. Wiki not answering, over its cap or restarting: on us-metal02 read `journalctl --user -u llm-wiki.service -n 200 --no-pager`, find the cause, and run `systemctl --user restart llm-wiki.service` only if it still does not answer; where pm2 runs it, read `PM2_HOME=.cache/pm2-dev node_modules/.bin/pm2 logs llm-wiki --lines 200 --nostream` in auto-sns-agent instead. Search or api-portal not answering: in auto-sns-agent read `PM2_HOME=.cache/pm2-dev node_modules/.bin/pm2 logs <search|api-portal> --lines 200 --nostream`, find the cause, and restart it with that pm2 only if it still does not answer. Convex or crawler: run `node scripts/dev/devstack.mjs status` and follow ops/runbooks/local-runtime.md. A crawler_boot item names an alembic revision the crawler's database holds and no file in apps/crawler-v3/alembic/versions has: find the job that wrote it (`git log --all -S <revision>` and `whose.mjs`), and have it commit that migration or run its downgrade and stamp the checkout's head. Restarting: find the root (dev-guard.mjs logs exits; `Stopping app` in .cache/pm2-dev/pm2.log is a restart command) and start one job that fixes it and builds its commit with `commit.mjs --object-only` for the chat. Tell the owner what broke and whether it answers now. Mac unusable minutes: read the owners and groups of those minutes in the Mac usable watch lines (~/.prime/agent/browser-chat/mac-usable/), cut what an agent started, and name any thread to pause, without opening or moving windows on his screen (c103). Mac dev servers not answering: read that app's pm2 log on the Mac, find the cause, and give the fix to the job or chat that owns the app. Mac Vent :8791 not answering: read `pm2 logs vent` and pm2.log on the Mac; pm2-boot, pm2-keep and devserver-heal start it from BOOT_APPS in scripts/sieun/mac/pm2-boot.mjs, so find why they did not. Mac Convex push stale: read the reason in the flagged item and `node scripts/repo/agent/convex-watcher.mjs status` on the Mac, and give the fix to the chat that owns the failing schema or function. Local Convex push stale (convex_push_stale): read the reason in the flagged item and `node scripts/repo/agent/convex-watcher.mjs status` in auto-sns-agent on us-metal02. A schema refusal of one local row (10-24 to 10-27 it was an [E2E] searchCrmViews row with no surface) is fixed in the local data, never by widening committed schema; a type error goes to the session that `node scripts/repo/agent/whose.mjs <file>` names. Store box swap over 6,000 MB: the store_box_swap line names its top processes; ssh a.@100.84.91.26, measure with top -l 1 -o mem and docker stats, restart the leaking process (sandboxd and System Events leaked on 10-27, root through ssh root@100.84.91.26) or the container that grew (convex grew from 1.95 GB to 4.55 GB in 8 days), following ops/runbooks/dev-boxes.md in auto-sns-agent. All on target: no message.
